entry.title: Bvlgari Holiday Season 2026 | Joy Is in Our Hands

media:group.media:title: Bvlgari Holiday Season 2026 | Joy Is in Our Hands
media:group.media:description:
Joy is in our hands. Bvlgari’s Holiday Season 2026 campaign celebrates gifting as an act of presence, care and connection.
For a Roman jeweler like Bvlgari, joy begins with the hands: in the Maison’s ateliers, where gestures refined over generations transform precious materials into objects of beauty, in the boutiques, where every gift is presented with the warmth of Italian hospitality, and in the final gesture of giving. Bvlgari brings the Italian Joy of Living to every gift, with creations crafted to be cherished for a lifetime.

entry.title: Creative Minds: Finding the Tempo with Gene Gallagher | Bvlgari

media:group.media:title: Creative Minds: Finding the Tempo with Gene Gallagher | Bvlgari
media:group.media:description:
Creative Minds, a new series highlighting an intimate look at creatives shaping their craft, navigating precision and the pursuit of mastery.
At Bvlgari Hotel London, Bvlgari Ambassador Gene Gallagher reflects on his songwriting process and the journey of bringing songs to life, wearing the new Octo Finissimo 37mm. Music and watchmaking meet through a shared appreciation for tempo, refined proportions and precision — principles that also define the evolution of the Octo Finissimo.
#Bvlgari #BvlgariHotels #BvlgariHotelLondon

entry.title: Bvlgari | Diwali: Behind Passing the Light

media:group.media:title: Bvlgari | Diwali: Behind Passing the Light
media:group.media:description: Material records everything. Doyel Joshi’s Passing the Light brings together the artist, the kumhar community and local craftswomen in an act of collective authorship. Comprising 4,500 hand-sculpted terracotta elements, the installation celebrates hope, light and togetherness for Diwali.

entry.title: Bvlgari Presents Passing the Light | Diwali 2026

media:group.media:title: Bvlgari Presents Passing the Light | Diwali 2026
media:group.media:description:
From earth to finished form, from one generation to the next.
Passing the Light follows the transformation of terracotta in the hands of Indian artisans, culminating in an installation of 4,500 elements inspired by traditional diyas. Created for Diwali by Bvlgari in collaboration with artist Doyel Joshi, the kumhar community and local craftswomen, the film celebrates the gestures, discipline and knowledge that connect craftsmanship across cultures.
#Bvlgari
